scientific_integrity: A complete analytic proof establishes the stated if-and-only-if characterization. A separate exact-arithmetic checker verifies the icosahedral realization and zonal identity. No independent mathematical verification or priority certification has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the exact degree-three eigenspace on the unit two-sphere, not arbitrary bandlimits or dimensions.
The mixed form uses intrinsic surface gradients and the displayed probability-measure normalizations.
Uniqueness of the mixing coefficient is asserted only for the regular icosahedral point configuration.
Previously known four-dimensional cubic point-value nullspace is credited to Hitchin; unindexed equivalent derivative cubature remains a possibility.
title: Derivative-repaired Parseval cubature for cubic spherical harmonics
